items.text: isko polite bana do: abhi file bhejo
items.answer: Please send the file now.

items.text: ise chhota kar do: maine socha aapko bata doon ki kal ki meeting cancel ho gayi hai aur nayi date baad mein batayenge

items.text: grammar theek karo: main kal office nahi aaya kyunki meri tabiyat kharab tha
